name: clinic-management-css-build
description: CSS minification build tooling for Clinic Management System - cz-css-1004 remediation. Minifies all unminified CSS/SCSS/LESS source assets via PostCSS/cssnano in the Docker multi-stage build pipeline, reducing ECR storage costs and Kubernetes pod startup time. CURRENT FIX BATCH (cz-css-1004): 30 occurrences in font-awesome.css (lines 1443-1546) covering icon glyph content declarations (.fa-cab:before/.fa-taxi:before through .fa-send-o:before/.fa-paper-plane-o:before) - all resolved by PostCSS/cssnano minification pass in Docker Stage 1 (css-minify). Specific occurrences: Line 1443 (.fa-cab:before/.fa-taxi:before content: \f1ba), Line 1446 (.fa-tree:before content: \f1bb), Line 1449 (.fa-spotify:before content: \f1bc), Line 1452 (.fa-deviantart:before content: \f1bd), Line 1455 (.fa-soundcloud:before content: \f1be), Line 1458 (.fa-database:before content: \f1c0), Line 1461 (.fa-file-pdf-o:before content: \f1c1), Line 1464 (.fa-file-word-o:before content: \f1c2), Line 1467 (.fa-file-excel-o:before content: \f1c3), Line 1470 (.fa-file-powerpoint-o:before content: \f1c4), Line 1475 (.fa-file-photo-o:before/.fa-file-picture-o:before/.fa-file-image-o:before content: \f1c5), Line 1479 (.fa-file-zip-o:before/.fa-file-archive-o:before content: \f1c6), Line 1483 (.fa-file-sound-o:before/.fa-file-audio-o:before content: \f1c7), Line 1487 (.fa-file-movie-o:before/.fa-file-video-o:before content: \f1c8), Line 1490 (.fa-file-code-o:before content: \f1c9), Line 1493 (.fa-vine:before content: \f1ca), Line 1496 (.fa-codepen:before content: \f1cb), Line 1499 (.fa-jsfiddle:before content: \f1cc), Line 1506 (.fa-life-bouy:before/.fa-life-buoy:before/.fa-life-saver:before/.fa-support:before/.fa-life-ring:before content: \f1cd), Line 1509 (.fa-circle-o-notch:before content: \f1ce), Line 1513 (.fa-ra:before/.fa-rebel:before content: \f1d0), Line 1517 (.fa-ge:before/.fa-empire:before content: \f1d1), Line 1520 (.fa-git-square:before content: \f1d2), Line 1523 (.fa-git:before content: \f1d3), Line 1528 (.fa-y-combinator-square:before/.fa-yc-square:before/.fa-hacker-news:before content: \f1d4), Line 1531 (.fa-tencent-weibo:before content: \f1d5), Line 1534 (.fa-qq:before content: \f1d6), Line 1538 (.fa-wechat:before/.fa-weixin:before content: \f1d7), Line 1542 (.fa-send:before/.fa-paper-plane:before content: \f1d8), Line 1546 (.fa-send-o:before/.fa-paper-plane-o:before content: \f1d9). Includes: style.css, font-awesome.css, bootstrap.css, form-elements.css, grid-view.css, patient-style.css, footer-distributed-with-address-and-phones.css, demo.css, font-awesome LESS files (animated, bordered-pulled, core, fixed-width, larger, list, mixins, path, rotated-flipped, stacked), and font-awesome SCSS files (_animated, _bordered-pulled, _core, _fixed-width, _larger, _list, _mixins, _path, _rotated-flipped, _stacked).
